meeting.title: Eng standup
meeting.notes: Daily standup. Round the room, blockers first.

transcript.text: Okay, let's get started, looks like everyone's here except Marco who's out today.
Same order as usual, Sarah you want to kick us off?
Sure. So yesterday I finished the empty states for the onboarding flow, the designs from Lena.
Today I'm going to start on the settings page migration to the new design system components.
No blockers, although the date picker in the design system is still a bit buggy on Safari.
Yeah, I saw that, I think Tom has a fix for the date picker somewhere.
I do, it's in review, should land today.
Cool. Tom, you're up then.
So most of yesterday was the Postgres upgrade on staging. We're on sixteen now, everything looks fine.
I want to do production next Tuesday early morning, so expect maybe ten minutes of read only mode.
Can you post that in the eng channel so support knows?
Yep, will do.
Also the iOS crash on launch for older devices, that turned out to be the font loading thing, fix is out in the next build.
Nice. Okay, Ethan, where are we on the webhook retries?
Yeah so the retry change is merged as of last night, it's behind the flag still.
I'll add the dead letter queue metrics to the webhook dashboard by tomorrow so we can actually see what's failing.
How are we doing the backoff, is it still linear?
Right now it's linear every five minutes, but I think we should move to exponential.
Yeah, exponential with a cap. What did we say, cap at one hour?
One hour seems right to me.
Okay so we're going with exponential backoff capped at one hour for webhooks, everyone fine with that?
Yep. Works for me.
For testing it end to end I still need the new Stripe sandbox keys, the old ones got rotated.
Oh, that's on me, I'll send you the new Stripe sandbox keys right after standup.
Thanks Priya.
Priya, while you're talking, how's the invoicing export going?
It's slow. The CSV export times out for the big customers, I'm going to try streaming it instead of building it in memory.
If you need a second pair of eyes on the streaming stuff, ping me.
Will do. That's it for me.
Okay. One more thing, Eathan, can you take a look at the rate limiter PR before the release cut on Thursday? It touches the webhook endpoints.
Sure, I'll review it today.
Great. Release cut is Thursday at noon as usual, so anything that isn't merged by then waits a week.
On hiring, we have two onsite interviews next week for the frontend role, I'll send the loop to whoever is on it.
Lena asked if anyone can give feedback on the new marketing site by Friday, link is in the design channel.
Also, reminder that the office is closed Monday for the holiday.
Is anyone else seeing the CI being really slow today? My builds took like twenty minutes.
Yeah, I think the cache got invalidated after the runner upgrade. It should warm up again.
Okay. Oh and lunch is tacos on Wednesday, put your order in the sheet.
Anything else? No? Alright, thanks everyone.
Thanks, bye.
